ambient_events: A dead sump pump squats in the corner, seized solid, water lapping at its housing.
The floor thrums faintly: the power plant's turbines, felt through a hundred feet of earth.
An amber light sweeps the far wall and is gone. You wait. It does not come again. Probably.
description: A pump chamber where the storm system once lifted its overflow toward the river, the great electric sump long dead and drowned. The concrete carries a constant low thrum from the power plant overhead. Passages run east to the turbine underflow and on down south into the deep trunk, and this is where the Architect's maintenance units come, when they come.
name: Machine Sump
